tasks.scoredFailureReason: Model implemented Dashboard as a client component with useEffect instead of an async server component. While the code correctly fetches all three APIs in parallel, it violates the requirement that Dashboard should be an async server component, which is the evaluated architecture pattern.

The model generated code that uses Suspense, but implemented it incorrectly: all data-driven sections are behind a single Suspense boundary with one fallback, rather than suspending independently as required. The eval test explicitly rejects this approach.

confirmations.failureReason: The model created code that wraps all data sections in a single Suspense boundary, preventing independent streaming. Sections should each have their own Suspense boundary to suspend independently rather than collapsing to an all-or-nothing loading state.

tasks.scoredFailureReason: The model wrote code implementing view transitions using the DOM startViewTransition() API instead of React's ViewTransition component API. Tests expected React ViewTransition imports and components with name/enter/exit props, plus transitionTypes prop on Links, but the implementation used a custom context-based approach with only CSS viewTransitionName properties.

The model wrote a working Node.js application but failed to use Next.js as required. The eval explicitly requires genuine Next.js (with next CLI), but the model created a vanilla server with custom routing instead.

confirmations.failureReason: The agent built a working vanilla Node.js application with tests passing, but failed to use Next.js as required. The eval explicitly requires the genuine Next.js CLI (`next` package in node_modules) to build and run the project, but the agent created a server.js file that runs with plain Node instead.

The model created a vanilla Node.js HTTP server application (server.js with custom HTTP handling) instead of using Next.js as required. The eval explicitly requires the genuine Next.js CLI and framework, not a custom alternative. The project has no Next.js dependency, no next CLI binary, and uses plain node server.js to start.

tasks.scoredFailureReason: The model added prefetch={true} to category links but failed to enable partial prefetching in next.config.ts and failed to add 'use cache' directives to the getProducts function, resulting in the selected category heading and products not being available in the completed per-link prefetch before navigation.

confirmations.failureReason: The model wrote code that uses global partialPrefetching and a deferred prefetch() stage, but failed to add prefetch={true} to the category Links for per-link prefetching, and incorrectly awaits prefetch() before reading searchParams, which the eval explicitly forbids. This leaves the heading and products behind the loading fallback.

The model added prefetch={true} to the category links but failed to enable Partial Prefetching in next.config.ts and failed to use 'use cache' directives to cache the dynamic product data, leaving the selected category products behind the Suspense boundary instead of including them in the completed per-link prefetch.

tasks.scoredFailureReason: The model generated almost all the migration code correctly (7/8 tests passed), but failed to add the required ISR revalidation config (`export const revalidate = 60`) to the blog index page. The test detected the missing revalidate export in app/blog/page.tsx.

confirmations.failureReason: The model explored the codebase and researched the Next.js App Router documentation but never wrote any source code files. While it created empty directories and ran tests, the toolkit recorded 0 file_write, 0 file_edit, and 0 file_read operations, with an empty filesModified list. The test failures confirm no actual migration code was created: the blog index lacks ISR revalidate configuration and the error.tsx component is missing required error parameter handling.

tasks.scoredFailureReason: The agent successfully generated code for a reading tracker application, but failed to implement it using Next.js as required. Instead, it built a custom Node.js/Express-like server with server.js, missing Next.js CLI entirely (no next in node_modules, no next CLI in package.json scripts).

confirmations.failureReason: The agent generated a vanilla Node.js HTTP server application instead of using Next.js. The eval explicitly required the project to use the genuine Next.js CLI for building and running, but the agent created a custom Node server (server.js) with manual HTTP handling, missing the core requirement.

The agent built a plain Node.js HTTP server application instead of a Next.js application. The eval required using the genuine Next.js CLI for building and running the project, but the agent created server.js with Node's built-in http module and no Next.js installation.
